doc.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Pontiac childhood, family and piano training
title: Exploring the piano through the player rolls
summary: Watching the rolls made him think he could play too, encouraged by his mother's and father's music.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Now, did you start to explore the piano before you had lessons?

Oh, yes. I was intrigued by the notes moving when the player portion of the piano was playing. You know, the roles. I said, “How does this happen?” I said – – somebody had obviously made the recording – – I said, "Well, if they can do it, maybe I can do it." I think it stimulates your thinking. And then, of course, my mother, being able to play the piano as well-- it stimulates from two or three different areas. My mother, my father being musicians, you know, like amateur musicians. The recordings that I listen to, the player piano, you know?
